purpose: Four new abstract launcher-icon concepts for user selection; no app integration.

concepts.name: 负形 S
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original minimal Android launcher icon concept for SPEKTRA / 光谱暗房, an analog-film photo editing app.
Primary request: a highly refined, contemporary, understated abstract brand symbol. The user rejected a literal three-dimensional filmstrip S and wants a simpler, less representational design. Aim for the economy and optical balance of a carefully drawn independent design-studio identity.
Composition: square canvas, completely flat solid-color full-bleed background reaching every edge, exactly one centered compact emblem, all geometry confined to the central 60 percent of the canvas, generous balanced negative space. Straight-on vector-like graphic, immaculate edges, intentional optical corrections.
Constraints: no text, no letters typed in a font, no captions, no watermark, no presentation board, no extra examples, no inset rounded-square tile, no border. No camera, filmstrip, sprocket holes, film canister, lens, shutter blades, mountains, sparkle stars, or realistic object. No 3D, bevel, extrusion, drop shadow, glass, chrome, material texture, glow or rainbow. No micro details or fragile thin strokes. Exactly one icon artwork.
Direction A — negative-space monogram, flat dark and orange.
Background: uniform graphite charcoal #141416.
Subject: one bold warm vermilion-orange #FF702F compact rounded lozenge or softly squared disk, approximately 57 percent of canvas width. Cut a confident dark flowing channel completely through it from the upper right edge to the lower left edge; the two opposed curved bites imply an abstract S in negative space. The orange masses stay visually unified as one compact symbol. The channel and outer radii have considered geometric relationships. A monogram reduced to mass and void, not a ribbon or the shape of a film object. Single solid orange fill, uniform solid dark cutout, no gradients. Memorable, quiet, polished, precise.
